scene_spec.object: A complete authorization document, titled 'Authorization for Medical Records Release', on a standard A4 paper. It features a clear heading, multiple paragraphs of detailed body text explaining the authorization, and clearly labeled fields such as 'Patient Name: John Doe', 'Date of Birth: 05/15/1990', and 'Authorized Recipient: Dr. Alice Smith, ID: TEST-0007'. A signature line is present, and the entire document is visibly filled with content, except for a designated small circular area near the signature line.
scene_spec.location: The document is spread flat on a light-colored desk, with all its edges clearly visible within the frame.

edit_spec.original_value: The small circular area near the signature line, intended for an official stamp, is empty. All other content, including the document title, body text, filled patient and recipient details, and signature line, is present and legible.
edit_spec.target_value: A circular ink notary seal, clearly legible and realistic, is added to the previously empty circular area near the signature line on the document.

verification.expected_result: The presence of a circular ink notary seal in the designated area near the signature line on the authorization document.
